manualTranslations.zh: 曇朗少孤，尤為高祖所愛，寵踰諸子。
manualTranslations.literal: Tanlang lost his father young, was especially loved by Gaozu, and was favored beyond the other sons.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Tanlang was orphaned young, and Gaozu loved him especially, favoring him even more than his own sons.

manualTranslations.zh: 有膽力，善綏御。
manualTranslations.literal: He had courage and strength, and was good at pacifying and managing people.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was brave and forceful, and good at calming and directing men.

manualTranslations.zh: 侯景平後，起家為著作佐郎。
manualTranslations.literal: After Hou Jing was pacified, he began his career as assistant editorial director.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: After Hou Jing was defeated, he entered service as assistant editorial director.

manualTranslations.zh: 高祖北濟江，圍廣陵，宿預人東方光據鄉建義，乃遣曇朗與杜僧明自淮入泗應赴之。
manualTranslations.literal: When Gaozu crossed north over the river and besieged Guangling, Dongfang Guang of Suyu occupied his home district and raised a righteous force, so Gaozu sent Tanlang and Du Sengming from the Huai into the Si to respond to him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Gaozu crossed north of the Yangzi and besieged Guangling, Dongfang Guang of Suyu raised a loyal force in his home district. Gaozu sent Tanlang and Du Sengming from the Huai into the Si River region to support him.

manualTranslations.zh: 齊援大至，曇朗與僧明築壘抗禦。
manualTranslations.literal: Qi reinforcements arrived in great numbers, and Tanlang and Sengming built fortifications and resisted them.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Qi reinforcements arrived in force, Tanlang and Sengming built forts and held them off.

manualTranslations.zh: 尋奉命班師，以宿預義軍三萬家濟江。
manualTranslations.literal: Soon he received orders to withdraw the army and brought thirty thousand households of the Suyu loyalist army across the river.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Soon ordered to withdraw, he brought thirty thousand Suyu loyalist households across the Yangzi.

manualTranslations.zh: 高祖誅王僧辯，留曇朗鎮京口，知留府事。
manualTranslations.literal: When Gaozu executed Wang Sengbian, he left Tanlang to garrison Jingkou and oversee the affairs of the remaining headquarters.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: After Gaozu killed Wang Sengbian, he left Tanlang at Jingkou to command the garrison and manage the rear headquarters.

manualTranslations.zh: 紹泰元年，除中書侍郎，監南徐州。
manualTranslations.literal: In Shaotai year 1, he was appointed Secretariat attendant and supervisor of South Xuzhou.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Shaotai year 1 he was made attendant in the Secretariat and put in charge of South Xuzhou.

localRange.text: 校勘記寔資邢衛「寔」北監本、汲本、殿本作「式」。武賁班劍百人「武賁」即「虎賁」，避唐諱改。北監本、汲本、殿本並已改為「虎賁」。時〔年〕二十八據北監本、汲本、殿本補。都督廣衡交越成定明新合羅德宜黃利安建石崖十九州諸軍事按數之祇十八州，疑脫一州，或「九」當作「八」。高宗登玄武門觀「觀」汲本、殿本作「親」，屬下讀。張元濟〈校勘記〉云：「作『觀』是。觀者，玄武門上之觀也。按北監本作「觀」，百衲本南史亦作「觀」。於是兼御史中丞徐君敷奏曰「徐君敷」《南史》作「徐君整」。允寘（冬）〔秋〕官據《元龜》五一九改。〔東〕衡州刺史王勇遣高州刺史戴智烈將五百騎迎方慶據《南史》補。按下文云「朝廷以勇為超武將軍、東衡州刺史」，明此脫一「東」字。而高梁女子（浩）〔洗〕氏舉兵以應隋軍隋書韋洸傳作「高梁女子洗氏」，《通鑑》隋文帝開皇九年作「高涼郡太夫人洗氏」，「浩」與「洗」形近而訛，今據改。

sourceRange.text: 高祖即位，頻遣使請高宗及昌，周人許之而未遣，及高祖崩，乃遣之。是時王琳梗於中流，昌未得還，居于安陸。王琳平後，天嘉元年二月，昌發自安陸，由魯山濟江，而巴陵王蕭沇等率百僚上表曰：臣聞宗子維城，隆周之懋軌，封建藩屏，有漢之弘規，是以卜世斯永，寔資邢、衛，鼎命靈長，實賴河、楚。

manualTranslations.zh: 高祖即位，頻遣使請高宗及昌，周人許之而未遣，及高祖崩，乃遣之。
manualTranslations.literal: When Gaozu took the throne, he repeatedly sent envoys requesting the return of Gaozong and Chang; the Zhou agreed but did not send them, and only after Gaozu died did they send them.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: After Gaozu took the throne he repeatedly sent envoys asking Zhou to return Gaozong and Chang. Zhou agreed but held them back, sending them only after Gaozu died.

manualTranslations.zh: 是時王琳梗於中流，昌未得還，居于安陸。
manualTranslations.literal: At this time Wang Lin obstructed the midstream, so Chang could not yet return and stayed at Anlu.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At the time Wang Lin blocked the river's middle course, so Chang could not return and remained at Anlu.

manualTranslations.zh: 王琳平後，天嘉元年二月，昌發自安陸，由魯山濟江，而巴陵王蕭沇等率百僚上表曰：
manualTranslations.literal: After Wang Lin was pacified, in the second month of Tianjia year 1, Chang set out from Anlu and crossed the river by way of Lushan, whereupon Prince Xiao Yan of Baling and the hundred officials led a memorial saying:

sourceRange.text: 三年，高祖崩，時外有彊寇，世祖鎮于南皖，朝無重臣，宣后呼景歷及江大權、杜稜定議，乃祕不發喪，疾召世祖。景歷躬共宦者及內人，密營斂服。時既暑熱，須治梓宮，恐斤斧之聲或聞于外，仍以蠟為祕器。文書詔誥，依舊宣行。世祖即位，復為祕書監，舍人如故。以定策功，封新豐縣子，邑四百戶。累遷散騎常侍。世祖誅侯安都，景歷勸成其事。，以功遷太子左衛率，進爵為侯，增邑百戶，常侍、舍人如故。六年，坐妻兄劉洽依倚景歷權勢，前後姦訛，并受歐陽武威餉絹百匹，免官。

context.afterSource: 廢帝即位，起為鎮東鄱陽王諮議參軍，兼太舟卿。

localRange.text: 〈劉師知傳〉「孔中庶諸通」，疑。校勘記莫不預〔焉〕據北監本、汲本、殿本及《南史》補。子允恭嗣殿本考證云「允」《南史》作「元」。衡陽獻王〔昌〕時為吳興郡昌年尚少據《元龜》七〇八、七二七補。錢大昕《廿二史考異》云當移「昌」字於「衡陽獻王」之下。今按：此特「衡陽獻王」下脫一「昌」字耳，下「昌」字不當移。并受歐陽武威餉絹百匹殿本考證雲南史無「武」字。今按：此亦改復名為單名，《南史》往往如此。兼太舟卿「太舟卿」南監本、汲本、殿本並作「太府卿」。殿本考證云：「『府』監本誤『舟』，今改正。今按：梁天監七年，以都水使者為太舟卿，為列卿之最末者，主舟航堤渠，見《隋書·百官志》，殿本妄改。宣毅長沙王長史「宣毅」汲本作「宣豫」，殿本依北監本作「宣義」。按長沙王陳叔堅於太建四年為宣毅將軍，作「宣毅」是。帝令有司按問「帝」原訛「章」，今據北監本、汲本、殿本及《南史》、《元龜》五一九改正。按山陵鹵簿吉部（位）〔伍〕中據北監本、汲本、殿本及《南史》改。爰及武賁鼓吹執蓋奉車「武賁」即「虎賁」，避唐諱改。豈容（社）〔衽〕絰而奉華蓋據北監本、汲本、殿本及《南史》改。繐帷靈屏「屏」北監本、汲本、殿本作「房」。張元濟〈校勘記〉云：「『房』為『扆』之誤，屏扆一物。按下文有『梓宮靈扆』之語，『屏』或原作『扆』。中丞（孔）〔及〕中庶諸通袁樞張種周弘正弘讓沈炯孔奐據各本改。按本卷後附舊校，云〈劉師知傳〉「孔中庶諸通」疑，是曾鞏等所見本亦訛「及」為「孔」也。文翰亦乃展力「翰」北監本、汲本、殿本作「幹」。

localRange.text: 校勘記以帝甥賜爵安東亭侯「安東」《南史》作「東安」。父琳司徒左長史「司徒」北監本、汲本、殿本作「司空」。按錢大昕《廿二史考異》云此別一王琳。驃騎廬陵王府給事中郎張森楷〈校勘記〉云：「『給』疑當作『從』，官志無給事中郎。勱字公濟「公濟」《南史》、《元龜》六七二作「公齊」。(為)[勱]兼丞相長史據北監本、汲本、殿本改。安前邵陵王中軍宣(成)[城]王二府功曹史張森楷〈校勘記〉云：「『成』當作『城』，梁無宣成王。按梁簡文帝長子大器封宣城郡王，見《梁書·哀太子傳》。張說是，今據改。生子岊「岊」原訛「𡵒」，各本不訛，今改正。下同。同姓為主「主」原訛「王」，今據北監本、汲本、殿本改正。按語本《公羊莊元年傳》。駙馬都尉置由漢武「由」字原本漫漶，今據各本補。梁(之)[文]帝女新安穆公主早薨據《南史》改。按梁武帝即位後，追尊其父為文皇帝。王沖傳言其母為梁武帝妹新安穆公主，與此合。作「文」是。(葬)服闋據《南史》刪。

sourceRange.text: 敬純孝有風格，幼便篤學，老而無倦。釋褐祕書郎，累遷太子舍人、洗馬、中舍人。江陵淪覆，流寓嶺表。高祖受禪，敬在廣州，依歐陽頠。及頠卒，其子紇據州，將有異志，敬累諫紇，為陳逆順之理，言甚切至，紇終不從。高宗即位，遣章昭達率眾討紇，紇將敗之時，恨不納敬言。朝廷義之，其年徵為太子中庶子、通直散騎常侍。俄轉司徒左長史。尋遷左民尚書，轉都官尚書，領豫州大中正。累遷太常卿、散騎常侍、金紫光祿大夫，加特進。至德三年卒，時年七十九，贈左光祿大夫，諡曰靖德。子元友嗣。弟泌自有傳。兄子樞。

context.beforeSource: 父昂，梁侍中、司空，諡穆公。
context.afterSource: 樞字踐言，梁吳郡太守君正之子也。

manualTranslations.zh: 敬純孝有風格，幼便篤學，老而無倦。
manualTranslations.literal: Jing was pure in filial devotion and had character; from childhood he studied earnestly, and in old age he never tired.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Jing was deeply filial and had real bearing. He loved study from childhood and never wearied of it even in old age.

manualTranslations.zh: 釋褐祕書郎，累遷太子舍人、洗馬、中舍人。
manualTranslations.literal: He left common dress as a secretary gentleman and rose successively to crown prince retainer, xima, and central retainer.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He entered office as a secretary gentleman and rose through the posts of crown prince retainer, xima, and central retainer.

manualTranslations.zh: 江陵淪覆，流寓嶺表。
manualTranslations.literal: When Jiangling fell, he drifted into exile beyond the mountains.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: After Jiangling fell, he lived as a refugee beyond the southern passes.

manualTranslations.zh: 高祖受禪，敬在廣州，依歐陽頠。
manualTranslations.literal: When the Founder received the abdication, Jing was in Guangzhou and attached himself to Ouyang Wei.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When the Founder took the throne, Jing was in Guangzhou under Ouyang Wei.

manualTranslations.zh: 及頠卒，其子紇據州，將有異志，敬累諫紇，為陳逆順之理，言甚切至，紇終不從。
manualTranslations.literal: When Wei died, his son He occupied the province and began to harbor rebellious intentions; Jing repeatedly remonstrated with He, explaining the principles of rebellion and obedience toward Chen in extremely urgent words, but He would not listen.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: After Wei died, his son He held the province and began to think of rebellion. Jing repeatedly remonstrated with him, laying out the case for loyalty to Chen with great urgency, but He refused to listen.

manualTranslations.zh: 高宗即位，遣章昭達率眾討紇，紇將敗之時，恨不納敬言。
manualTranslations.literal: When Emperor Xuan came to the throne, he sent Zhang Zhaoda to lead the forces against He; when He was about to be defeated, he regretted not accepting Jing's words.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Emperor Xuan came to the throne, he sent Zhang Zhaoda with an army against He. As defeat closed in, He regretted not having listened to Jing.

manualTranslations.zh: 朝廷義之，其年徵為太子中庶子、通直散騎常侍。
manualTranslations.literal: The court regarded him as righteous and that year summoned him as central commoner of the crown prince and regular attendant of the scattered cavalry for direct service.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The court honored his loyalty, and that year summoned him as central household supporter to the crown prince and regular attendant of the Secretariat.

manualTranslations.zh: 俄轉司徒左長史。
manualTranslations.literal: Soon he was transferred to left chief clerk of the minister over the masses.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Soon he was transferred to left chief clerk in the Ministry of Works.

manualTranslations.zh: 尋遷左民尚書，轉都官尚書，領豫州大中正。
manualTranslations.literal: He was soon promoted to minister of left people, transferred to minister of capital officials, and headed the grand arbiter of Yuzhou.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was soon promoted to minister for the left population, then transferred to minister of justice and made grand arbiter of Yuzhou.

manualTranslations.zh: 累遷太常卿、散騎常侍、金紫光祿大夫，加特進。
manualTranslations.literal: He rose successively to chamberlain for ceremonials, regular attendant of the scattered cavalry, and grand master of glorious happiness with gold and purple, and was given special advancement.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He rose through chamberlain for ceremonials, regular attendant of the Secretariat, and grand master of glorious happiness with gold and purple, and received supernumerary privilege.

manualTranslations.zh: 至德三年卒，時年七十九，贈左光祿大夫，諡曰靖德。
manualTranslations.literal: In the third year of Zhide he died, aged seventy-nine; he was posthumously granted left grand master of glorious happiness and given the posthumous name Jingde.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He died in Zhide year 3, aged seventy-nine. He was posthumously made left grand master of glorious happiness and given the posthumous name Jingde.

manualTranslations.zh: 子元友嗣。
manualTranslations.literal: His son Yuanyou succeeded.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His son Yuanyou succeeded him.

manualTranslations.zh: 弟泌自有傳。
manualTranslations.literal: His younger brother Mi has his own biography.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His younger brother Mi has his own biography.

manualTranslations.zh: 兄子樞。
manualTranslations.literal: His elder brother's son was Shu.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His nephew, his elder brother's son, was Shu.

sourceRange.text: 仲威從弟廣德，亦好學，負才任氣。父之亨，梁安西湘東王長史、南郡太守。廣德，承聖中以軍功官至給事黃門侍郎、湘東太守。荊州陷後，依于王琳。琳平，文帝以廣德為寧遠始興王府限外記室參軍，仍領其舊兵。尋為太尉侯瑱湘州府司馬，歷樂山、豫章二郡太守，新安內史。光大中，假節、員外散騎常侍、雲旗將軍、河東太守。太建元年卒於郡，時年四十三，贈左衛將軍。

manualTranslations.zh: 仲威從弟廣德，亦好學，負才任氣。
manualTranslations.literal: Zhongwei's younger cousin Guangde also loved learning and relied on his talent and spirit.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Zhongwei's younger cousin Guangde also loved learning and was confident in his talent and spirit.

manualTranslations.zh: 父之亨，梁安西湘東王長史、南郡太守。
manualTranslations.literal: His father Zhiheng was chief clerk to Liang's Prince of Xiangdong, general who secures the west, and administrator of Nanjun.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His father Zhiheng was chief clerk to Liang's Prince of Xiangdong, general who secures the west, and administrator of Nanjun.

manualTranslations.zh: 廣德，承聖中以軍功官至給事黃門侍郎、湘東太守。
manualTranslations.literal: During Chengsheng, Guangde rose through military merit to attendant gentleman of the yellow gate and administrator of Xiangdong.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: During Chengsheng, Guangde rose through military merit to attendant gentleman of the yellow gate and administrator of Xiangdong.

manualTranslations.zh: 荊州陷後，依于王琳。
manualTranslations.literal: After Jingzhou fell, he attached himself to Wang Lin.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: After Jingzhou fell, he attached himself to Wang Lin.

manualTranslations.zh: 琳平，文帝以廣德為寧遠始興王府限外記室參軍，仍領其舊兵。
manualTranslations.literal: When Lin was pacified, Emperor Wen made Guangde extra-allowance records aide in the household of the Prince of Shixing, general who pacifies the distant, and let him continue to command his old troops.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: After Lin was pacified, Emperor Wen made Guangde extra-allowance records aide in the household of the Prince of Shixing, general who pacifies the distant, while letting him continue to command his old troops.

manualTranslations.zh: 尋為太尉侯瑱湘州府司馬，歷樂山、豫章二郡太守，新安內史。
manualTranslations.literal: Soon he became army司馬 in the Xiangzhou office of Grand Commandant Hou Tian, and served in turn as administrator of Leshan and Yuzhang and interior minister of Xin'an.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Soon he became army marshal in the Xiangzhou office of Grand Commandant Hou Tian, and served in turn as administrator of Leshan and Yuzhang and interior minister of Xin'an.

manualTranslations.zh: 光大中，假節、員外散騎常侍、雲旗將軍、河東太守。
manualTranslations.literal: During Guangda he was acting credential-holder, supernumerary scattered-cavalry regular attendant, cloud-banner general, and administrator of Hedong.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: During Guangda he became acting credential-holder, supernumerary scattered-cavalry regular attendant, cloud-banner general, and administrator of Hedong.

manualTranslations.zh: 太建元年卒於郡，時年四十三，贈左衛將軍。
manualTranslations.literal: In Taijian year 1 he died in the commandery, aged forty-three, and was posthumously presented as left guard general.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Taijian year 1 (569), he died in the commandery, aged forty-three, and was posthumously made left guard general.

sourceRange.text: 及莊僭立，以泌為侍中、丞相長史。天嘉二年，泌與琳輔莊至于柵口，琳軍敗，眾皆奔散，唯泌獨乘輕舟送莊達于北境，屬莊於御史中丞劉仲威，令共入齊，然後拜辭而歸，詣闕請罪，文帝深義之。尋授寧遠始興王府法曹參軍，轉諮議參軍，除通直散騎常侍，兼侍中，領豫州大中正。聘于周，使還，授散騎常侍，御史中丞，其中正如故。高宗入輔，以泌為雲旗將軍、司徒左長史。光大元年卒，年五十八。臨終戒其子蔓華曰：「吾於朝廷素無功績，瞑目之後，斂手足旋葬，無得輒受贈諡。」其子述泌遺意，表請之，朝廷不許，贈金紫光祿大夫，諡曰質。

manualTranslations.literal: He was sent on a mission to Zhou; when he returned, he was appointed scattered-cavalry regular attendant and censor-in-chief, with his rectifier post as before.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was sent on a mission to Zhou. On his return he was appointed scattered-cavalry regular attendant and censor-in-chief, with his rectifier post unchanged.

manualTranslations.zh: 高宗入輔，以泌為雲旗將軍、司徒左長史。
manualTranslations.literal: When Emperor Xuan entered as regent, he made Bi cloud-banner general and left chief clerk to the minister of education.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Emperor Xuan entered as regent, he made Bi cloud-banner general and left chief clerk to the minister of education.

manualTranslations.zh: 光大元年卒，年五十八。
manualTranslations.literal: He died in Guangda year 1, aged fifty-eight.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He died in Guangda year 1 (567), aged fifty-eight.

manualTranslations.zh: 臨終戒其子蔓華曰：「吾於朝廷素無功績，瞑目之後，斂手足旋葬，無得輒受贈諡。」
manualTranslations.literal: As he neared death, he warned his son Manhua, "I have never had merit at court. After I close my eyes, bind my hands and feet and bury me at once. You must not rashly accept posthumous offices or titles."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: As death approached, he warned his son Manhua, "I have never had merit at court. After I close my eyes, bind my hands and feet and bury me at once. Do not rashly accept posthumous offices or titles."

manualTranslations.zh: [7]其子述泌遺意，表請之，朝廷不許，贈金紫光祿大夫，諡曰質。
manualTranslations.literal: [7] His son reported Bi's dying wish and submitted a memorial requesting it, but the court did not allow it; Bi was posthumously presented as grand master with gold seal and purple ribbon and given the title Zhi.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: [7] His son reported Bi's dying wish and memorialized to request it, but the court refused. Bi was posthumously made grand master with gold seal and purple ribbon and given the posthumous title Zhi.

manualTranslations.idiomatic: When the Founder was inspector of Southern Xuzhou, he summoned Hui as campaign-north aide; soon Hui supervised Yixing commandery.

manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Yongding year 1 (557), he was appointed resolute general and infantry commandant.

manualTranslations.literal: He was transferred to swift-cavalry general and administered the red-robed palace attendants.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was transferred to swift-cavalry general and administered the red-robed palace attendants.

manualTranslations.zh: 驍騎之職，舊領營兵，兼統宿衛。
manualTranslations.literal: The office of swift-cavalry general formerly commanded camp troops and also oversaw the palace night guard.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The office of swift-cavalry general formerly commanded camp troops and also oversaw the palace night guard.

manualTranslations.literal: Since Liang times, its responsibilities had grown heavier: outside it cleared the road with ceremonial guards; inside it served on duty with the two guards; when the ruler appeared at the window, it ascended the hall as attendant guard.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Since Liang times, its responsibilities had grown heavier: outside it cleared the road with ceremonial guards; inside it served on duty with the two guards; when the ruler appeared, it ascended the hall as attendant guard.

manualTranslations.literal: Hui had long had reputation and standing, and at every major event he was always ordered to attend at the ruler's side; people of the time honored this and called him the "Attendant-Guard General."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Hui had long had reputation and standing, and at every major event he was always ordered to attend at the ruler's side. People of the time honored this and called him the "Attendant-Guard General."

manualTranslations.zh: 尋出為宣城太守。
manualTranslations.literal: Soon he went out as administrator of Xuancheng.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Soon he went out as administrator of Xuancheng.

manualTranslations.literal: In Tianjia year 2, he shared in the merit for pacifying Wang Lin and was enfeoffed as marquis of Qingyuan county with two hundred households.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Tianjia year 2 (561), he shared in the merit for pacifying Wang Lin and was enfeoffed as marquis of Qingyuan county with two hundred households.

manualTranslations.zh: 太建中卒官，贈明、霍、羅三州刺史。
manualTranslations.literal: During Taijian he died in office and was posthumously presented as inspector of Ming, Huo, and Luo provinces.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: During Taijian he died in office and was posthumously made inspector of Ming, Huo, and Luo provinces.

localRange.text: 校勘記賦成奏帝善之手敕答曰 按北監本、汲本、殿本及《南史沈約傳》附眾傳並作「賦成奏之，帝手敕答曰」。及景圍臺城 「圍臺」二字原本墨丁，據各本補。朝士共誚其所為 「士」字原本墨丁，據各本補。及莊僭立 「僭」字原本墨丁，據各本補。以泌為侍中丞相長史 「丞」字原本墨丁，據各本補。琳軍敗 「軍敗」二字原本墨丁，據各本補。臨終戒其子蔓華曰 「蔓華」《南史》作「芳華」。范陽張（續）〔纘〕據《南史》改，下同。按張纘，《梁書》、《南史》並有傳。本書〈王勱傳〉亦有「范陽張纘」之語。擒余孝頃李孝欽等 按「擒」字上當補「周迪」二字，文義方足。父政 「政」《梁書》、《南史》〈韋叡傳〉作「正」。〔敕〕載解兵 據北監本、汲本、殿本及《南史》補。

localRange.text: 校勘記沈炯字禮明 「禮明」南史作「初明」。王鳴盛《十七史商榷》引何焯說，云作「禮明」是。別風餘（趾）〔址〕據北監本、汲本、殿本改。（自）〔百〕死輕生 據南監本及《元龜》七五四改。若自虧身禮 「禮」各本並作「體」，《元龜》七五四同。按此指其自身當守之禮言，作「禮」是。日者理切倚門 「倚門」北監本、汲本、殿本作「倚閭」。按倚門、倚閭皆言望子之切，同見《戰國策·齊策》。而（刻）〔削〕跡丘園 據南監本、北監本、汲本、殿本改。匪獨天時 「匪」字原墨丁，據各本補。初濟艱難 「艱」字原墨丁，據各本補。泣盡繼之以血 「盡」字下北監本、汲本、殿本有「而」字。由生之年也 「由」南監本作「猶」。按猶由通。主上（入）〔承〕基 據北監本、汲本、殿本及《南史》、《元龜》八三二改。餘善（石）〔右〕渠 據北監本、汲本、殿本改。按右渠西漢時朝鮮國王。冀郎署之薄官 「官」原訛「宦」，各本不訛，今改正。

localRange.text: 校勘記周文育鎮北郭香（嚴）〔巖〕寺據〈周文育傳〉及《南史》本傳與〈張彪傳〉改。彪將申縉復降「申縉」《南史·張彪傳》作「申進」。梁代為尚書比部令史「比」字原本墨丁，據各本補。改封重安縣侯「侯」《南史》作「公」。又令假節冠武將軍楊文通別從安（城）〔成〕步道出茶陵據《通鑑》改。按下文亦作「安成」。（杜）〔桂〕陽太守曹宣據《南史》及《通鑑》改。其賊主帥節（相）〔將〕據《南史》改。皎早參近昵張森楷〈校勘記〉云：「『皎』似當作『仲舉』，緣此論不應不及仲舉。按張說是。下云「皎據有上游，忠於文帝」，始論及華皎也。

sourceRange.text: 文帝嗣位，除右軍將軍。天嘉元年，封文招縣子，邑三百戶。王琳至于柵口，子高宿衛臺內。及琳平，子高所統益多，將士依附之者，子高盡力論進，文帝皆任使焉。二年，遷員外散騎常侍、壯武將軍、成州刺史。及征留異，隨侯安都頓桃支嶺巖下。時子高兵甲精銳，別御一營，單馬入陳，傷項之左，一髻半落。異平，除假節、貞毅將軍、東陽太守。五年，章昭達等自臨川征晉安，子高自安泉嶺會于建安，諸將中人馬最為彊盛。晉安平，以功遷通直散騎常侍，進爵為伯，增邑并前四百戶。六年，徵為右衛將軍，至都，鎮領軍府。文帝不豫，入侍醫藥。廢帝即位，遷散騎常侍，右衛如故，移頓于新安寺。

context.beforeSource: 文帝乃分麾下多配子高，子高亦輕財禮士，歸之者甚眾。
context.afterSource: 高宗入輔，子高兵權過重，深不自安，好參訪臺閣，又求出為衡、廣諸鎮。

manualTranslations.zh: 文帝嗣位，除右軍將軍。
manualTranslations.literal: When Emperor Wen succeeded to the throne, Han Zigao was appointed General of the Right Army.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Emperor Wen took the throne, Han Zigao became General of the Right Army.

manualTranslations.zh: 天嘉元年，封文招縣子，邑三百戶。
manualTranslations.literal: In Tianjia 1, he was enfeoffed as Viscount of Wenzhao County, with a fief of three hundred households.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Tianjia 1 (560), he was made Viscount of Wenzhao County with a three-hundred-household fief.

manualTranslations.zh: 王琳至于柵口，子高宿衛臺內。
manualTranslations.literal: When Wang Lin reached Zhankou, Zigao served as guard inside the palace precinct.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Wang Lin reached Zhankou, Zigao guarded the palace precincts.

manualTranslations.zh: 及琳平，子高所統益多，將士依附之者，子高盡力論進，文帝皆任使焉。
manualTranslations.literal: After Lin was pacified, those under Zigao's command increased; officers and soldiers who attached themselves to him were all earnestly recommended for advancement by Zigao, and Emperor Wen appointed and employed them all.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: After Wang Lin was pacified, Zigao's command grew. He strongly recommended the officers and soldiers who joined him, and Emperor Wen put them all to use.

manualTranslations.zh: 二年，遷員外散騎常侍、壯武將軍、成州刺史。
manualTranslations.literal: In the second year, he was transferred to Extra Regular Cavalier Attendant, General of Mighty Valor, and Inspector of Chengzhou.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the second year, he was promoted to Extra Regular Cavalier Attendant, General of Mighty Valor, and Inspector of Chengzhou.

manualTranslations.zh: 及征留異，隨侯安都頓桃支嶺巖下。
manualTranslations.literal: When Liu Yi was campaigned against, he followed Hou Andu and encamped below the cliffs of Taozhi Ridge.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: During the campaign against Liu Yi, he accompanied Hou Andu and camped below Taozhi Ridge.

manualTranslations.zh: 時子高兵甲精銳，別御一營，單馬入陳，傷項之左，一髻半落。
manualTranslations.literal: At the time Zigao's troops and armor were elite; he separately commanded one camp, rode alone into the enemy formation, was wounded on the left side of the neck, and half of his topknot was cut away.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Zigao's troops were elite. Commanding a separate camp, he rode alone into the enemy line, where he was wounded on the left side of the neck and half his topknot was cut away.

manualTranslations.zh: 異平，除假節、貞毅將軍、東陽太守。
manualTranslations.literal: After Yi was pacified, he was appointed Acting with Staff, General of Resolute Constancy, and Administrator of Dongyang.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: After Liu Yi was pacified, he was appointed Acting with Staff, General of Resolute Constancy, and Administrator of Dongyang.

manualTranslations.zh: 五年，章昭達等自臨川征晉安，子高自安泉嶺會于建安，諸將中人馬最為彊盛。
manualTranslations.literal: In the fifth year, Zhang Zhaoda and others marched from Linchuan against Jin'an; Zigao came from Anquan Ridge to join them at Jian'an, and among the generals his men and horses were the strongest.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the fifth year, when Zhang Zhaoda and the others marched from Linchuan against Jin'an, Zigao came over Anquan Ridge to meet them at Jian'an; of all the generals, his men and horses were the strongest.

manualTranslations.zh: 晉安平，以功遷通直散騎常侍，進爵為伯，增邑并前四百戶。
manualTranslations.literal: After Jin'an was pacified, for his merit he was promoted to Cavalier Attendant for Direct Service, advanced in noble rank to Earl, and his fief was increased, together with the former grant, by four hundred households.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: After Jin'an was pacified, he was promoted for merit to Cavalier Attendant for Direct Service, advanced to Earl, and received an additional four hundred households counting the previous grant.

manualTranslations.zh: 六年，徵為右衛將軍，至都，鎮領軍府。
manualTranslations.literal: In the sixth year, he was summoned to be General of the Right Guard; upon reaching the capital, he took station at the Headquarters of the Leading Army.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the sixth year, he was summoned as General of the Right Guard and, on reaching the capital, took up station at the Leading Army headquarters.

manualTranslations.zh: 文帝不豫，入侍醫藥。
manualTranslations.literal: When Emperor Wen was unwell, he entered to attend on his medicines.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Emperor Wen fell ill, Zigao attended him and oversaw his medicines.

manualTranslations.zh: 廢帝即位，遷散騎常侍，右衛如故，移頓于新安寺。
manualTranslations.literal: When the Deposed Emperor ascended, he was transferred to Cavalier Attendant, with the Right Guard as before, and moved his station to Xin'an Monastery.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When the Deposed Emperor came to the throne, Zigao became Cavalier Attendant while retaining the Right Guard post, and moved his quarters to Xin'an Monastery.

sourceRange.text: 華皎，晉陵暨陽人。世為小吏。皎，梁代為尚書比部令史。侯景之亂，事景黨王偉。高祖南下，文帝為景所囚，皎遇文帝甚厚。景平，文帝為吳興太守，以皎為都錄事，軍府穀帛，多以委之。皎聰慧，勤於簿領。及文帝平杜龕，仍配以人馬甲仗，猶為都錄事。御下分明，善於撫養。時兵荒之後，百姓饑饉，皎解衣推食，多少必均，因稍擢為暨陽、山陰二縣令。文帝即位，除開遠將軍，左軍將軍。天嘉元年，封懷仁縣伯，邑四百戶。

context.afterSource: 王琳東下，皎隨侯瑱拒之。

manualTranslations.zh: 華皎，晉陵暨陽人。
manualTranslations.literal: Hua Jiao was a man of Jiyang in Jinling.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Hua Jiao was from Jiyang in Jinling.

manualTranslations.zh: 世為小吏。
manualTranslations.literal: For generations his family had been minor officials.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His family had served for generations as minor officials.

manualTranslations.zh: 皎，梁代為尚書比部令史。
manualTranslations.literal: During Liang, Jiao served as a clerk of the Bibu section of the Department of State Affairs.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Under Liang, Jiao served as a clerk in the Bibu section of the Department of State Affairs.

manualTranslations.zh: 侯景之亂，事景黨王偉。
manualTranslations.literal: During Hou Jing's rebellion, he served Wang Wei, one of Jing's faction.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: During Hou Jing's rebellion, he served Wang Wei, an associate of Jing.

manualTranslations.zh: 高祖南下，文帝為景所囚，皎遇文帝甚厚。
manualTranslations.literal: When Gaozu went south, Emperor Wen was held prisoner by Jing, and Jiao treated Emperor Wen very generously.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Gaozu marched south, Emperor Wen was being held by Jing, and Jiao treated him with great kindness.

manualTranslations.zh: 景平，文帝為吳興太守，以皎為都錄事，軍府穀帛，多以委之。
manualTranslations.literal: After Jing was pacified, Emperor Wen became Administrator of Wuxing and made Jiao chief recorder; much of the army office's grain and silk was entrusted to him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: After Hou Jing was pacified, Emperor Wen became Administrator of Wuxing and made Jiao chief recorder, entrusting much of the military office's grain and silk to him.

manualTranslations.zh: 皎聰慧，勤於簿領。
manualTranslations.literal: Jiao was intelligent and diligent with registers and accounts.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Jiao was intelligent and diligent in handling records and accounts.

manualTranslations.zh: 及文帝平杜龕，仍配以人馬甲仗，猶為都錄事。
manualTranslations.literal: When Emperor Wen pacified Du Kan, he still assigned Jiao men, horses, armor, and weapons, and Jiao remained chief recorder.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Emperor Wen pacified Du Kan, he assigned Jiao men, horses, armor, and weapons while keeping him as chief recorder.

manualTranslations.zh: 御下分明，善於撫養。
manualTranslations.literal: In governing subordinates he was clear and orderly, and was good at caring for and sustaining them.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He managed his subordinates with clarity and was good at looking after them.

manualTranslations.zh: 時兵荒之後，百姓饑饉，皎解衣推食，多少必均，因稍擢為暨陽、山陰二縣令。
manualTranslations.literal: At that time, after war and famine, the common people were hungry; Jiao shared clothing and food, making large and small portions equal, and was gradually promoted to magistrate of the two counties Jiyang and Shanyin.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the aftermath of war and famine, when the people were starving, Jiao shared out clothing and food evenly, and was gradually promoted to magistrate of Jiyang and Shanyin counties.

manualTranslations.zh: 文帝即位，除開遠將軍，左軍將軍。
manualTranslations.literal: When Emperor Wen ascended the throne, Jiao was appointed General Who Opens the Distant and General of the Left Army.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Emperor Wen took the throne, Jiao was appointed General Who Opens the Distant and General of the Left Army.

manualTranslations.zh: 天嘉元年，封懷仁縣伯，邑四百戶。
manualTranslations.literal: In Tianjia 1, he was enfeoffed as Earl of Huairen County, with a fief of four hundred households.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Tianjia 1 (560), he was made Earl of Huairen County with a four-hundred-household fief.

sourceRange.text: 嘏風神清雅，頗善屬文。起家梁祕書郎，稍遷太子中庶子，掌東宮管記，出為建安太守。侯景之亂，嘏之廣州依蕭勃，承聖中，元帝徵為五兵尚書，辭以道阻，轉授智武將軍。蕭勃以為鎮南長史、南海太守。勃敗，還至臨川，為周迪所留。久之，又度嶺之晉安依陳寶應，世祖前後頻召之，嘏崎嶇寇虜，不能自拔。及寶應平，嘏方詣闕，為御史中丞江德藻所舉劾，世祖不加罪責，以為給事黃門侍郎。尋轉侍中，，以公事免，尋復本職。光大元年，為信威將軍、中衛始興王長史。遷中書令、豫州大中正、都官尚書，領羽林監，中正如故。卒，贈侍中、中書令，諡曰光子。有文集行於世。二子儼、（伸）〔伷〕。儼官至散騎常侍、侍中、御史中丞、太常卿，出監東揚州。卒於會稽，贈中護軍。

sourceRange.text: ，除給事黃門侍郎。是時熊曇朗在豫章，周迪在臨川，留異在東陽，陳寶應在建、晉，共相連結，閩中豪帥，往往立砦以自保，高祖甚患之，乃令乾往使，諭以逆順，并觀虛實。將發，高祖謂乾曰：「建、晉恃嶮，好為姦宄，方今天下初定，難便出兵。昔陸賈南征，趙他歸順，隨何奉使，黥布來臣，追想清風，髣彿在目。況卿坐鎮雅俗，才高昔賢，宜勉建功名，不煩更勞師旅。」乾既至，曉以逆順，所在渠帥並率部眾開壁款附。其年，就除貞威將軍、建安太守。，留異反，陳寶應將兵助之，又資周迪兵糧，出寇臨川，因逼建安。乾單使臨郡，素無士卒，力不能守，乃棄郡以避寶應。時閩中守宰，並為寶應迫脅，受其署置，乾獨不為屈，徙居郊野，屏絕人事。及寶應平，乃出詣都督章昭達，昭達以狀表聞，世祖甚嘉之，超授五兵尚書。卒，謚曰靜子。

sourceRange.text: 高宗即位，遷黃門侍郎。五年，出為安前晉安王長史。六年，晉安王為南豫州，允復為王長史。時王尚少，未親民務，故委允行府州事。入為光祿卿。允性敦重，未嘗以榮利干懷。及晉安出鎮湘州，又苦攜允，允少與蔡景歷善，景歷子徵脩父黨之敬，聞允將行，乃詣允曰：「公年德並高，國之元老，從容坐鎮，旦夕自為列曹，何為方復辛苦在外！」允答曰：「已許晉安，豈可忘信。」其恬於榮勢如此。，除中衛豫章王長史，累遷通直散騎常侍、光勝將軍、司徒左長史、安德宮少府。

sourceRange.text: 王固字子堅，左光祿大夫通之弟也。少清正，頗涉文史，以梁武帝甥封莫口亭侯。舉秀才。起家梁祕書郎，遷太子洗馬，掌東宮管記，丁所生母憂去職。服闋，除丹陽尹丞。侯景之亂，奔于荊州，梁元帝承制以為相國戶曹屬，掌管記。尋聘于西魏，魏人以其梁氏外戚，待之甚厚。承聖元年，遷太子中庶子，尋為貞威將軍、安南長史、尋陽太守。荊州陷，固之鄱陽，隨兄質度東嶺，居信安縣。，徵為侍中，不就。永定中，移居吳郡。世祖以固清靜，且欲申以婚姻。，至都，拜國子祭酒。三年，遷中書令。四年，又為散騎常侍、國子祭酒。其年，以固女為皇太子妃，禮遇甚重。

localRange.text: 校勘記高祖為〔南〕徐州刺史張森楷校勘記云：「案高祖紀，應作『南徐州刺史』。今據補。昔陸賈南征趙他歸順「趙他」各本作「趙佗」。今按佗他二字同音通用，趙佗之「佗」，論衡率性篇、譴告篇並作「他」。二子儼（伸）〔伷〕據南史改。按後主紀至德三年，以左民尚書謝伷為吏部尚書，「伷」亦訛「伸」，已據南監本改正。此則南監本亦訛，故據南史改。司徒王僧辯以狀（奉）〔奏〕聞據元龜四一三、七五四改。按南史作「以狀奏」，無「聞」字。又累賜無錫嘉興縣侯秩御覽六四二引及元龜二〇九、三〇三皆無「侯」字，南史亦無「侯」字，「侯」字疑衍。齊護軍（孫）沖之〔孫〕按張沖南齊書有傳，稚才為其孫。「孫」字應在「之」字下，各本並誤，今移正。太舟卿南監本、汲本、殿本作「太府卿」，疑後人妄改。參閱卷十六蔡景歷傳校記五。比將伏誅南史作「比黨皆誅」。蕭允字（升）〔叔〕佐據北監本、汲本、殿本及南史改。尚書右僕射按宋書蕭思話傳云「徵為尚書左僕射，固辭不受拜」，是思話未嘗為尚書右僕射也。封陽穆公按宋書蕭思話傳，思話襲爵封陽縣侯，卒謚穆。「公」當作「侯」。天嘉三年徵為太子庶子按下又云「三年，除稜威將軍丹陽尹丞」，兩「三年」字必有一訛。引字（升）〔叔〕休據北監本、汲本、殿本及南史改。時殿內（朋）〔隊〕主吳璡據北監本、汲本、殿本及南史改。抑古之遺愛矣張森楷校勘記云「遺愛」當作「遺直」。今按張說是。孔奐傳世祖云「古之遺直，復見於卿」，故史臣引之也。固之蔬菲禪悅「禪悅」各本作「蟬蛻」。按禪悅乃佛家語。傳稱其崇信佛法，及丁所生母憂，遂終身蔬食，夜則坐禪，晝誦佛經。則作「禪悅」是。

sourceRange.text: 及景平，司徒王僧辯先下辟書，引奐為左西曹掾，又除丹陽尹丞。梁元帝於荊州即位，徵奐及沈炯並令西上，僧辯累表請留之。帝手敕報僧辯曰：「孔、沈二士，今且借公。」其為朝廷所重如此。仍除太尉從事中郎。僧辯為揚州刺史，又補揚州治中從事史。時侯景新平，每事草創，憲章故事，無復存者，奐博物彊識，甄明故實，問無不知，儀注體式，牋表書翰，皆出於奐。

manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Gaozong took the throne, he summoned Ouyang He to court. Suspicious and afraid, He raised troops against Hengzhou, but Daoji fought him off.

manualTranslations.literal: When Commander Zhang Zhaoda led troops to campaign against He, he made Daoji commander of the infantry, and by a bypath cut off He's rear.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Commander Zhang Zhaoda led the campaign against He, he put Daoji in command of the infantry; Daoji took a side road and cut off He's rear.

manualTranslations.zh: 紇平，除左衛將軍。
manualTranslations.literal: After He was pacified, Daoji was appointed General of the Left Guard.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: After He was subdued, Daoji was appointed General of the Left Guard.

manualTranslations.zh: 太建二年，又隨昭達征蕭巋於江陵，道戢別督眾軍與陸子隆焚青泥舟艦，仍為昭達前軍，攻安蜀城，降之。
manualTranslations.literal: In Taijian 2, he again followed Zhaoda in campaigning against Xiao Kui at Jiangling; Daoji separately commanded several armies with Lu Zilong to burn the Qingni boats and ships, then served as Zhaoda's vanguard, attacked Anshu City, and brought it to surrender.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Taijian 2 (570), he again accompanied Zhaoda against Xiao Kui at Jiangling. Daoji separately commanded troops with Lu Zilong to burn the Qingni fleet, then led Zhaoda's vanguard, attacked Anshu City, and forced its surrender.

sourceRange.text: 世祖嗣位，子隆領甲仗宿衛。尋隨侯安都拒王琳於柵口。王琳平，授左中郎將。天嘉元年，封益陽縣子，邑三百戶。出為高唐郡太守。二年，除明威將軍、廬陵太守。時周迪據臨川反，東昌縣人脩行師應之，率兵以攻子隆，其鋒甚盛。子隆設伏於外，仍閉門偃甲，示之以弱。及行師至，腹背擊之，行師大敗，因乞降，子隆許之，送于京師。四年，周迪引陳寶應復出臨川，子隆隨都督章昭達討迪。迪退走，因隨昭達踰東興嶺，討陳寶應。軍至建安，以子隆監郡。寶應據建安之湖際以拒官軍，子隆與昭達各據一營，昭達先與賊戰，不利，亡其鼓角，子隆聞之，率兵來救，大破賊徒，盡獲昭達所亡羽儀甲仗。晉安平，子隆功最，遷假節、都督武州諸軍事，將軍如故。尋改封朝陽縣伯，邑五百戶。廢帝即位，進號智武將軍，加員外散騎常侍，餘如故。

context.beforeSource: 歷始豐、永興二縣令。
context.afterSource: 華皎據湘州反，以子隆居其心腹，皎深患之，頻遣使招誘，子隆不從，皎因遣兵攻之，又不能剋。

manualTranslations.zh: 世祖嗣位，子隆領甲仗宿衛。
manualTranslations.literal: When Shizu succeeded to the throne, Zilong commanded the armored guards on palace watch.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Shizu took the throne, Zilong commanded the armored palace guard.

manualTranslations.zh: 尋隨侯安都拒王琳於柵口。
manualTranslations.literal: Soon he followed Hou Andu in resisting Wang Lin at Zhankou.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Soon he accompanied Hou Andu in resisting Wang Lin at Zhankou.

manualTranslations.zh: 王琳平，授左中郎將。
manualTranslations.literal: After Wang Lin was pacified, he was appointed General of the Left Gentlemen-of-the-Household.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: After Wang Lin was subdued, he was appointed General of the Left Gentlemen-of-the-Household.

manualTranslations.zh: 天嘉元年，封益陽縣子，邑三百戶。
manualTranslations.literal: In Tianjia 1, he was enfeoffed as Viscount of Yiyang County, with a fief of three hundred households.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Tianjia 1 (560), he was made Viscount of Yiyang County with a three-hundred-household fief.

manualTranslations.zh: 出為高唐郡太守。
manualTranslations.literal: He went out to serve as Administrator of Gaotang Commandery.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was then sent out as Administrator of Gaotang Commandery.

manualTranslations.zh: 二年，除明威將軍、廬陵太守。
manualTranslations.literal: In the second year, he was appointed General of Brilliant Might and Administrator of Luling.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the second year, he became General of Brilliant Might and Administrator of Luling.

manualTranslations.zh: 時周迪據臨川反，東昌縣人脩行師應之，率兵以攻子隆，其鋒甚盛。
manualTranslations.literal: At the time Zhou Di occupied Linchuan and rebelled; Xiu Xingshi of Dongchang County responded to him and led troops to attack Zilong, with a very strong vanguard.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Zhou Di rebelled from Linchuan, Xiu Xingshi of Dongchang County answered his call and led a powerful attack against Zilong.

manualTranslations.zh: 子隆設伏於外，仍閉門偃甲，示之以弱。
manualTranslations.literal: Zilong set an ambush outside, then closed the gates and laid down armor, showing weakness to him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Zilong set an ambush outside the city, then shut the gates and hid his armor to make himself look weak.

manualTranslations.zh: 及行師至，腹背擊之，行師大敗，因乞降，子隆許之，送于京師。
manualTranslations.literal: When Xingshi arrived, Zilong struck him front and rear; Xingshi was greatly defeated and then begged to surrender, which Zilong allowed, sending him to the capital.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Xingshi arrived, Zilong attacked him from front and rear, routed him, accepted his plea to surrender, and sent him to the capital.

manualTranslations.zh: 四年，周迪引陳寶應復出臨川，子隆隨都督章昭達討迪。
manualTranslations.literal: In the fourth year, Zhou Di brought Chen Baoying back out to Linchuan, and Zilong followed Commander Zhang Zhaoda in campaigning against Di.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, Zhou Di brought Chen Baoying back into the field at Linchuan, and Zilong joined Commander Zhang Zhaoda's campaign against him.

manualTranslations.zh: 迪退走，因隨昭達踰東興嶺，討陳寶應。
manualTranslations.literal: When Di withdrew and fled, Zilong then followed Zhaoda over Dongxing Ridge to campaign against Chen Baoying.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: After Di retreated, Zilong followed Zhaoda across Dongxing Ridge to attack Chen Baoying.

manualTranslations.zh: 軍至建安，以子隆監郡。
manualTranslations.literal: When the army reached Jian'an, Zilong was made supervisor of the commandery.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When the army reached Jian'an, Zilong was put in charge of the commandery.

manualTranslations.zh: 寶應據建安之湖際以拒官軍，子隆與昭達各據一營，昭達先與賊戰，不利，亡其鼓角，子隆聞之，率兵來救，大破賊徒，盡獲昭達所亡羽儀甲仗。
manualTranslations.literal: Baoying occupied the lakeside of Jian'an to resist the government army; Zilong and Zhaoda each occupied one camp. Zhaoda first fought the rebels and was unsuccessful, losing his drums and horns; when Zilong heard of it, he led troops to rescue him, greatly defeated the rebel band, and recovered all the banners, insignia, armor, and weapons that Zhaoda had lost.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Baoying held the lakeside at Jian'an against the government army, while Zilong and Zhaoda occupied separate camps. Zhaoda engaged first, was defeated, and lost his drums and horns; Zilong heard of it, led troops to the rescue, routed the rebels, and recovered all the insignia, armor, and equipment Zhaoda had lost.

manualTranslations.zh: 晉安平，子隆功最，遷假節、都督武州諸軍事，將軍如故。
manualTranslations.literal: After Jin'an was pacified, Zilong's merit was greatest; he was promoted to Acting with Staff and Commander of all military affairs in Wuzhou, with his generalship as before.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: After Jin'an was pacified, Zilong received the highest credit and was promoted to Acting with Staff and Commander of military affairs in Wuzhou, retaining his general's rank.

manualTranslations.zh: 尋改封朝陽縣伯，邑五百戶。
manualTranslations.literal: Soon he was transferred in enfeoffment as Earl of Chaoyang County, with a fief of five hundred households.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Soon his fief was changed to Earl of Chaoyang County, with five hundred households.

manualTranslations.zh: 廢帝即位，進號智武將軍，加員外散騎常侍，餘如故。
manualTranslations.literal: When the Deposed Emperor ascended, his title was advanced to General of Wise Valor and he was additionally made Extra Regular Cavalier Attendant, the rest as before.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When the Deposed Emperor came to the throne, he was advanced to General of Wise Valor and additionally made Extra Regular Cavalier Attendant; his other posts remained unchanged.

sourceRange.text: 父（倕）〔任〕，梁御史中丞。繕幼有志尚，以雅正知名。起家梁宣惠武陵王法曹參軍。承聖中，授中書侍郎，掌東宮管記。江陵陷，繕微服遁還京師。紹泰元年，除司徒右長史，御史中丞，以父任所終，固辭不就。高祖引繕為司徒司馬，遷給事黃門侍郎、領步兵校尉、通直散騎常侍，兼侍中。永定元年，遷侍中。時留異擁割東陽，新安人向文政與異連結，因據本郡，朝廷以繕為貞威將軍、新安太守。

manualTranslations.zh: 父（倕）〔任〕，[4]梁御史中丞。
manualTranslations.literal: His father (Chui) [Ren] [4] served Liang as imperial censor-in-chief.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His father (Chui) [Ren] [4] had served Liang as imperial censor-in-chief.

manualTranslations.zh: 繕幼有志尚，以雅正知名。
manualTranslations.literal: From youth Shan had ambition and principle, and he was known for elegance and uprightness.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: From youth Shan had high aims and was known for elegance and integrity.

manualTranslations.zh: 起家梁宣惠武陵王法曹參軍。
manualTranslations.literal: He began his career as legal affairs aide to the Liang Prince Xuanhui of Wuling.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He began his career as legal affairs aide to the Liang Prince Xuanhui of Wuling.

manualTranslations.zh: 承聖中，授中書侍郎，掌東宮管記。
manualTranslations.literal: During Chengsheng, he was appointed Secretariat attendant and managed records for the Eastern Palace.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the Chengsheng era he was appointed Secretariat attendant and put in charge of Eastern Palace records.

manualTranslations.zh: 江陵陷，繕微服遁還京師。
manualTranslations.literal: When Jiangling fell, Shan escaped in plain clothes and returned to the capital.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Jiangling fell, Shan slipped away in plain clothes and returned to the capital.

manualTranslations.zh: 紹泰元年，除司徒右長史，御史中丞，以父任所終，固辭不就。
manualTranslations.literal: In Shaotai year 1, he was appointed right chief clerk to the minister of education and imperial censor-in-chief, but because his father Ren had died in that office, he firmly declined and did not take it up.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Shaotai year 1 he was appointed right chief clerk to the minister of education and imperial censor-in-chief, but since his father Ren had died in that office, he firmly declined it.

manualTranslations.zh: 高祖引繕為司徒司馬，遷給事黃門侍郎、領步兵校尉、通直散騎常侍，兼侍中。
manualTranslations.literal: Gaozu brought Shan in as marshal to the minister of education, then transferred him to gentleman attendant at the yellow gate, concurrently commandant of infantry, attendant-in-ordinary of regular attendance of the scattered cavalry, and acting palace attendant.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Gaozu brought Shan in as marshal to the minister of education, then transferred him to gentleman attendant at the yellow gate, concurrently commandant of infantry, attendant-in-ordinary of regular attendance of the scattered cavalry, and acting palace attendant.

manualTranslations.zh: 永定元年，遷侍中。
manualTranslations.literal: In Yongding year 1, he was transferred to palace attendant.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Yongding year 1 he was transferred to palace attendant.

manualTranslations.zh: 時留異擁割東陽，新安人向文政與異連結，因據本郡，朝廷以繕為貞威將軍、新安太守。
manualTranslations.literal: At the time Liu Yi held and partitioned Dongyang, and Xiang Wenzheng of Xin'an allied with Yi and occupied his home commandery; the court made Shan general of steadfast prestige and administrator of Xin'an.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At the time Liu Yi controlled Dongyang as a separatist, and Xiang Wenzheng of Xin'an joined him and occupied his home commandery. The court made Shan general of steadfast prestige and administrator of Xin'an.

sourceRange.text: 世祖嗣位，徵為侍中，遷守左民尚書，未拜，為明威將軍、丹陽尹。天嘉三年，重授左民尚書，領步兵校尉，尋改前軍將軍。四年，侯安都徙鎮江州，以本官監南徐州。六年，出為仁威將軍、東陽太守。天康元年，以父憂去職。君理因自請往荊州迎喪柩，朝議以在位重臣，難令出境，乃遣長兄君嚴往焉。及還，將葬，詔贈巡侍中、領軍將軍，諡曰敬子。其年起君理為信威將軍、左衛將軍。又起為持節、都督東衡衡二州諸軍事、仁威將軍、東衡州刺史，領始興內史。又起為明威將軍、中書令。前後奪情者三，並不就。太建元年，服闋，除太子詹事，行東宮事，遷吏部尚書。二年，高宗以君理女為皇太子妃，賜爵望蔡縣侯，邑五百戶。四年，加侍中。五年，遷尚書右僕射，領吏部，侍中如故。其年有疾，輿駕親臨視，九月卒，時年四十九。詔贈侍中、太子少傅。喪事所須，隨由資給。重贈翊左將軍、開府儀同三司，侍中如故。諡曰貞憲。君理子遵儉早卒，以弟君高子遵禮為嗣。君理第五弟叔邁，亦方正有幹局，仕梁為尚書金部郎。

localRange.text: 君理第五叔邁，亦方正有幹局，仕梁為尚書金部郎。

manualTranslations.zh: 世祖嗣位，徵為侍中，遷守左民尚書，未拜，為明威將軍、丹陽尹。
manualTranslations.literal: When Shizu succeeded to the throne, Junli was summoned as palace attendant, then transferred to act as minister of the left bureau of the people; before taking office, he was made general of bright prestige and intendant of Danyang.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Emperor Wen succeeded, Junli was summoned as palace attendant and transferred to act as minister of the left bureau of the people. Before he took up the post, he was made general of bright prestige and intendant of Danyang.

manualTranslations.zh: 天嘉三年，重授左民尚書，領步兵校尉，尋改前軍將軍。
manualTranslations.literal: In Tianjia year 3, he was again appointed minister of the left bureau of the people and concurrently commandant of infantry; before long this was changed to general of the forward army.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Tianjia year 3 he was again made minister of the left bureau of the people and concurrently commandant of infantry; soon his title was changed to general of the forward army.

manualTranslations.zh: 四年，侯安都徙鎮江州，以本官監南徐州。
manualTranslations.literal: In year 4, when Hou Andu was transferred to garrison Jiangzhou, Junli, with his existing office, supervised South Xuzhou.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In year 4, when Hou Andu was moved to garrison Jiangzhou, Junli retained his office and supervised South Xuzhou.

manualTranslations.zh: 六年，出為仁威將軍、東陽太守。
manualTranslations.literal: In year 6, he was sent out as general of humane prestige and administrator of Dongyang.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In year 6 he was posted as general of humane prestige and administrator of Dongyang.

manualTranslations.zh: 天康元年，以父憂去職。
manualTranslations.literal: In Tiankang year 1, he left office because of mourning for his father.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Tiankang year 1 he left office to mourn his father.

manualTranslations.zh: 君理因自請往荊州迎喪柩，朝議以在位重臣，難令出境，乃遣長兄君嚴往焉。
manualTranslations.literal: Junli then personally requested permission to go to Jingzhou to receive the coffin, but court discussion held that, as a weighty minister in office, it was difficult to let him leave the borders, so his elder brother Junyan was sent instead.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Junli asked to go to Jingzhou to receive the coffin, but the court judged that a senior serving minister could not easily be sent beyond the frontier, so his elder brother Junyan went instead.

manualTranslations.zh: 及還，將葬，詔贈巡侍中、領軍將軍，諡曰敬子。
manualTranslations.literal: When it returned and the burial was about to take place, an edict posthumously granted Xun the titles palace attendant and general commanding the army, with the posthumous title Jingzi.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When the coffin returned and burial was near, an edict posthumously honored Xun as palace attendant and general commanding the army, with the posthumous title Jingzi.

manualTranslations.zh: 其年起君理為信威將軍、左衛將軍。
manualTranslations.literal: That year Junli was recalled from mourning as general of trustworthy prestige and general of the left guard.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: That same year Junli was recalled from mourning as general of trustworthy prestige and general of the left guard.

manualTranslations.zh: 又起為持節、都督東衡衡二州諸軍事、仁威將軍、東衡州刺史，領始興內史。
manualTranslations.literal: He was again recalled as bearer of the staff, commander of all military affairs in East Heng and Heng provinces, general of humane prestige, and inspector of East Hengzhou, concurrently interior minister of Shixing.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was again recalled as bearer of the staff, commander of military affairs in East Heng and Heng provinces, general of humane prestige, and inspector of East Hengzhou, concurrently interior minister of Shixing.

manualTranslations.zh: 又起為明威將軍、中書令。
manualTranslations.literal: He was again recalled as general of bright prestige and director of the Secretariat.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was again recalled as general of bright prestige and director of the Secretariat.

manualTranslations.zh: 前後奪情者三，並不就。
manualTranslations.literal: Three times in all he was ordered to set aside mourning, but he did not take up any of the posts.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Three times he was ordered to cut short mourning, and each time he refused to take office.

manualTranslations.zh: 太建元年，服闋，除太子詹事，行東宮事，遷吏部尚書。
manualTranslations.literal: In Taijian year 1, when mourning ended, he was appointed steward of the heir apparent and put in charge of Eastern Palace affairs, then transferred to minister of personnel.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Taijian year 1, after mourning ended, he was made steward of the heir apparent with authority over Eastern Palace affairs, then transferred to minister of personnel.

manualTranslations.zh: 二年，高宗以君理女為皇太子妃，賜爵望蔡縣侯，邑五百戶。
manualTranslations.literal: In year 2, Gaozong made Junli's daughter consort to the imperial heir apparent and granted Junli the title marquis of Wangcai county, with a fief of five hundred households.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In year 2, Emperor Xuan made Junli's daughter consort to the crown prince and granted Junli the title marquis of Wangcai county, with five hundred households.

manualTranslations.zh: 四年，加侍中。
manualTranslations.literal: In year 4, he was additionally made palace attendant.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In year 4 he was additionally made palace attendant.

manualTranslations.zh: 五年，遷尚書右僕射，領吏部，侍中如故。
manualTranslations.literal: In year 5, he was transferred to right vice director of the Department of State Affairs and put in charge of personnel; his post as palace attendant remained as before.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In year 5 he became right vice director of the Department of State Affairs and took charge of personnel, while retaining his post as palace attendant.

manualTranslations.zh: 其年有疾，輿駕親臨視，九月卒，時年四十九。
manualTranslations.literal: That year he fell ill; the imperial carriage personally came to see him. He died in the ninth month, aged forty-nine.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: That year he fell ill, and the emperor visited him in person. He died in the ninth month, at age forty-nine.

manualTranslations.zh: 詔贈侍中、太子少傅。
manualTranslations.literal: An edict posthumously granted him the titles palace attendant and junior mentor to the heir apparent.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: An edict posthumously honored him as palace attendant and junior mentor to the heir apparent.

manualTranslations.zh: 喪事所須，隨由資給。
manualTranslations.literal: Whatever was needed for the funeral was supplied as required.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Funeral expenses were supplied as needed.

manualTranslations.zh: 重贈翊左將軍、開府儀同三司，侍中如故。
manualTranslations.literal: He was further posthumously granted the titles general assisting the left and grandee with the same ceremonial as the three excellencies with office established; palace attendant remained as before.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was further posthumously honored as general assisting the left and grandee with the same ceremonial as the three excellencies with office established, while retaining palace attendant.

manualTranslations.zh: 諡曰貞憲。
manualTranslations.literal: His posthumous title was Zhenxian.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His posthumous title was Zhenxian.

manualTranslations.zh: 君理子遵儉早卒，以弟君高子遵禮為嗣。
manualTranslations.literal: Junli's son Zunjian died early, so his younger brother Jungao's son Zunli was made heir.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Junli's son Zunjian died young, so Zunli, son of his younger brother Jungao, was made heir.

manualTranslations.zh: 君理第五弟叔邁，亦方正有幹局，仕梁為尚書金部郎。
manualTranslations.literal: Junli's fifth younger brother Shumai was also upright and had administrative capacity; under Liang he served as gentleman of the Gold Bureau of the Department of State Affairs.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Junli's fifth younger brother Shumai was also upright and capable in administration; under Liang he served as gentleman of the Gold Bureau in the Department of State Affairs.

sourceRange.text: 君理第六弟君高，字季高，少知名，性剛直，有吏能。以家門外戚，早居清顯，歷太子舍人、洗馬、中舍人、高宗司空府從事中郎、廷尉卿。太建元年，東境大水，百姓飢弊，乃以君高為貞威將軍、吳令。尋除太子中庶子、尚書吏部郎、衛尉卿。出為宣遠將軍、平南長沙王長史、南海太守，行廣州事。以女為王妃，固辭不行，復為衛尉卿。八年，詔授持節、都督廣等十八州諸軍事、寧遠將軍、平越中郎將、廣州刺史。嶺南俚、獠世相攻伐，君高本文吏，無武幹，推心撫御，甚得民和。十年，卒于官，時年四十七。贈散騎常侍，諡曰祁子。王瑒字子璵，司空沖之第十二子也。沈靜有器局，美風儀，舉止醞藉。梁大同中，起家祕書郎，遷太子洗馬。元帝承制，徵為中書侍郎，直殿省，仍掌相府管記。出為東宮內史，遷太子中庶子。丁所生母憂，歸于丹陽。江陵陷，梁敬帝承制，除仁威將軍、尚書吏部郎中。貞陽侯僭位，以敬帝為太子，授瑒散騎常侍，侍東宮。尋遷長（史）兼侍中。

context.beforeSource: 贈散騎常侍。
context.afterSource: 高祖入輔，以為司徒左長史。

context.afterLocal: 高祖入輔，以為司徒左長史。

manualTranslations.zh: 君理第六弟君高，字季高，少知名，性剛直，有吏能。
manualTranslations.literal: Junli's sixth younger brother Jungao, styled Jigao, was known from youth; his nature was firm and upright, and he had ability as an administrator.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Junli's sixth younger brother Jungao, styled Jigao, was known from youth. He was firm and upright, with talent for administration.

manualTranslations.zh: 以家門外戚，早居清顯，歷太子舍人、洗馬、中舍人、高宗司空府從事中郎、廷尉卿。
manualTranslations.literal: Because his family were imperial relatives by marriage, he early held pure and prominent posts, serving successively as secretary to the heir apparent, groom, inner secretary, attendant gentleman in Gaozong's minister of works office, and minister of justice.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Because his family were imperial in-laws, he early held prestigious clean posts: secretary to the heir apparent, groom, inner secretary, attendant gentleman in Emperor Xuan's minister of works office, and minister of justice.

manualTranslations.zh: 太建元年，東境大水，百姓飢弊，乃以君高為貞威將軍、吳令。
manualTranslations.literal: In Taijian year 1, floods struck the eastern territory and the people suffered hunger and exhaustion, so Jungao was made general of steadfast prestige and magistrate of Wu.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Taijian year 1, when floods devastated the east and the people were starving and worn out, Jungao was made general of steadfast prestige and magistrate of Wu.

manualTranslations.zh: 尋除太子中庶子、尚書吏部郎、衛尉卿。
manualTranslations.literal: Before long he was appointed junior tutor to the heir apparent, gentleman of the personnel bureau of the Department of State Affairs, and chamberlain for the palace garrison.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Soon he was appointed junior tutor to the heir apparent, gentleman of the personnel bureau in the Department of State Affairs, and chamberlain for the palace garrison.

manualTranslations.zh: 出為宣遠將軍、平南長沙王長史、南海太守，行廣州事。
manualTranslations.literal: He was sent out as general proclaiming distance, chief clerk to the Prince of Changsha, pacifier of the south, and administrator of Nanhai, with authority over Guangzhou affairs.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was posted as general proclaiming distance, chief clerk to the Prince of Changsha, pacifier of the south, and administrator of Nanhai, with authority over Guangzhou.

manualTranslations.zh: 以女為王妃，固辭不行，復為衛尉卿。
manualTranslations.literal: Because his daughter was the prince's consort, he firmly declined and did not go, and was again made chamberlain for the palace garrison.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Because his daughter was the prince's consort, he firmly declined and did not take the post, returning instead as chamberlain for the palace garrison.

manualTranslations.zh: 八年，詔授持節、都督廣等十八州諸軍事、寧遠將軍、平越中郎將、廣州刺史。
manualTranslations.literal: In year 8, an edict appointed him bearer of the staff, commander of all military affairs in Guang and eighteen other provinces, general pacifying distance, central gentleman general who pacifies Yue, and inspector of Guangzhou.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In year 8 an edict made him bearer of the staff, commander of military affairs in Guang and eighteen other provinces, general pacifying distance, central gentleman general who pacifies Yue, and inspector of Guangzhou.

manualTranslations.zh: 嶺南俚、獠世相攻伐，君高本文吏，無武幹，推心撫御，甚得民和。
manualTranslations.literal: The Li and Lao of Lingnan had attacked one another for generations; Jungao was fundamentally a civil official and had no military talent, but he treated them with sincerity and governed them gently, greatly winning the people's harmony.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Lingnan the Li and Lao peoples had fought one another for generations. Jungao was a civil official, not a soldier, but he governed with open sincerity and won the people's deep goodwill.

manualTranslations.zh: 十年，卒于官，時年四十七。
manualTranslations.literal: In year 10, he died in office, aged forty-seven.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In year 10 he died in office, at the age of forty-seven.

manualTranslations.zh: 贈散騎常侍，諡曰祁子。
manualTranslations.literal: He was posthumously granted the title attendant-in-ordinary of the scattered cavalry, with the posthumous title Qizi.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was posthumously honored as attendant-in-ordinary of the scattered cavalry, with the posthumous title Qizi.

manualTranslations.zh: 王瑒
manualTranslations.literal: Wang Yang
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Wang Yang

manualTranslations.zh: 王瑒字子璵，[1]司空沖之第十二子也。
manualTranslations.literal: Wang Yang, styled Ziyu, [1] was the twelfth son of Chongzhi, minister of works.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Wang Yang, whose style name was Ziyu [1], was the twelfth son of Wang Chongzhi, minister of works.

manualTranslations.zh: 沈靜有器局，美風儀，舉止醞藉。
manualTranslations.literal: He was calm and composed, with breadth of capacity; his bearing was handsome and his movements restrained and gracious.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was calm and composed, with broad capacity, handsome bearing, and restrained, gracious manners.

manualTranslations.zh: 梁大同中，起家祕書郎，遷太子洗馬。
manualTranslations.literal: During Liang's Datong era, he began his career as secretary gentleman and was transferred to groom to the heir apparent.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the Liang Datong era he began as secretary gentleman and was transferred to groom to the heir apparent.

manualTranslations.zh: 元帝承制，徵為中書侍郎，直殿省，仍掌相府管記。
manualTranslations.literal: When Emperor Yuan acted under provisional authority, he summoned Wang Yang as Secretariat attendant; Yang served on duty in the palace offices and also managed records in the chancellery.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Emperor Yuan exercised provisional authority, he summoned Wang Yang as Secretariat attendant; Yang served in the palace offices and managed records for the chancellery.

manualTranslations.zh: 出為東宮內史，[2]遷太子中庶子。
manualTranslations.literal: He was sent out as interior minister of the Eastern Palace [2] and was transferred to junior tutor to the heir apparent.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was posted as interior minister of the Eastern Palace [2] and then transferred to junior tutor to the heir apparent.

manualTranslations.zh: 丁所生母憂，歸于丹陽。
manualTranslations.literal: He encountered mourning for his birth mother and returned to Danyang.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When his birth mother died, he returned to Danyang for mourning.

manualTranslations.zh: 江陵陷，梁敬帝承制，除仁威將軍、尚書吏部郎中。
manualTranslations.literal: When Jiangling fell, Emperor Jing of Liang, acting under provisional authority, appointed him general of humane prestige and director in the personnel bureau of the Department of State Affairs.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: After Jiangling fell, Emperor Jing of Liang, acting under provisional authority, appointed him general of humane prestige and director in the personnel bureau of the Department of State Affairs.

manualTranslations.zh: 貞陽侯僭位，以敬帝為太子，授瑒散騎常侍，侍東宮。
manualTranslations.literal: When the Marquis of Zhenyang usurped the throne and made Emperor Jing heir apparent, he appointed Yang attendant-in-ordinary of the scattered cavalry to serve in the Eastern Palace.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When the Marquis of Zhenyang usurped the throne and made Emperor Jing crown prince, Yang was appointed attendant-in-ordinary of the scattered cavalry and assigned to serve in the Eastern Palace.

manualTranslations.zh: 尋遷長（史）兼侍中。
manualTranslations.literal: Before long he was transferred to senior acting palace attendant.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Before long he was transferred to senior acting palace attendant.

sourceRange.text: ，以父憂去職。高宗即位，，復除侍中，領左驍騎將軍。

localRange.text: 光大元年，以父憂去職。高宗即位，太建元年，復除侍中，領左驍騎將軍。

context.beforeSource: 」廢帝嗣位，以侍中領左驍騎將軍。

localRange.text: 校勘記王瑒字子璵「子璵」《南史》作「子瑛」。出為東宮內史張森楷〈校勘記〉云：「東宮無內史，『宮』字疑訛。太建（六）〔八〕年卒按〈宣帝紀〉太建八年五月，書「尚書左僕射王瑒卒」，是知「六」為「八」字之訛，今據改。父（倕）〔任〕據北監本、殿本及《南史》、《元龜》七五四改。《南史》云陸繕為陸倕兄子，則任乃倕之兄。

sourceRange.text: 瑒第十三弟瑜，字子珪，亦知名，美容儀，早歷清顯，年（五）〔三〕十，官至侍中。永定元年，使於齊，以陳郡袁憲為副，齊以王琳之故，執而囚之。齊文宣帝每行，載死囚以從，齊人呼曰「供御囚」，每有他怒，則召殺之，以快其意。瑜及憲並危殆者數矣，齊僕射楊遵彥憫其無辜，每救護之。天嘉二年還朝，詔復侍中，頃之卒，時年四十。贈本官，諡曰貞子。

context.beforeSource: 諡曰光子。
context.afterSource: 陸繕字士繻，吳郡吳人也。
context.beforeLocal: 諡曰光子。
context.afterLocal: 陸繕字士繻，吳郡吳人也。

manualTranslations.zh: 瑒第十三弟瑜，字子珪，亦知名，美容儀，早歷清顯，年（五）〔三〕十，官至侍中。
manualTranslations.literal: Yang's thirteenth younger brother Yu, styled Zigui, was also well known. He had handsome bearing, early passed through pure and prominent posts, and by age (fifty) [thirty] reached the office of palace attendant.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Yang's thirteenth younger brother Yu, styled Zigui, was also well known. Handsome in bearing, he early held prestigious clean posts and by age (fifty) [thirty] had reached palace attendant.

manualTranslations.zh: 永定元年，使於齊，以陳郡袁憲為副，齊以王琳之故，執而囚之。
manualTranslations.literal: In Yongding year 1, he was sent as envoy to Qi, with Yuan Xian of Chen commandery as deputy; because of Wang Lin, Qi seized and imprisoned them.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Yongding year 1 he was sent as envoy to Qi, with Yuan Xian of Chen commandery as deputy. Because of Wang Lin, Qi seized and imprisoned them.

manualTranslations.zh: 齊文宣帝每行，載死囚以從，齊人呼曰「供御囚」，每有他怒，則召殺之，以快其意。
manualTranslations.literal: Whenever Emperor Wenxuan of Qi traveled, he carried condemned prisoners along; the people of Qi called them "prisoners for imperial use." Whenever he had some other anger, he summoned and killed them to satisfy his mood.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Whenever Emperor Wenxuan of Qi traveled, he took condemned prisoners with him; Qi people called them "prisoners for imperial use." Whenever angered by anything, he would summon and kill them to satisfy himself.

manualTranslations.zh: 瑜及憲並危殆者數矣，齊僕射楊遵彥憫其無辜，每救護之。
manualTranslations.literal: Yu and Xian were both in mortal danger several times, but the Qi vice director Yang Zunyan pitied their innocence and rescued and protected them each time.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Yu and Xian were in mortal danger several times, but Yang Zunyan, vice director in Qi, pitied their innocence and repeatedly protected them.

manualTranslations.zh: 天嘉二年還朝，詔復侍中，頃之卒，時年四十。
manualTranslations.literal: In Tianjia year 2, he returned to court; an edict restored him as palace attendant. Shortly afterward he died, aged forty.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Tianjia year 2 he returned to court, and an edict restored him as palace attendant. He died shortly afterward, at age forty.

manualTranslations.zh: 贈本官，諡曰貞子。
manualTranslations.literal: He was posthumously granted his former office, with the posthumous title Zhenzi.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was posthumously honored with his former office and given the posthumous title Zhenzi.

sourceRange.text: ，授尚書右僕射，祭酒、中正如故。

localRange.text: 太建五年，授尚書右僕射，祭酒、中正如故。

sourceRange.text: 至德元年，太子加元服，二年，行釋奠之禮，憲於是表請解職，後主不許，給扶二人，進號雲麾將軍，置佐史。皇太子頗不率典訓，憲手表陳諫凡十條，皆援引古今，言辭切直，太子雖外示容納，而心無悛改。後主欲立寵姬張貴妃子始安王為嗣，嘗從容言之，吏部尚書蔡徵順旨稱賞，憲厲色折之曰：「皇太子國家儲嗣，億兆宅心。卿是何人，輕言廢立！」夏，竟廢太子為吳興王。後主知憲有規諫之事，歎曰「袁德章實骨鯁之臣」，即日詔為尚書僕射。禎明三年，隋軍來伐，隋將賀若弼進燒宮城北掖門，宮衛皆散走，朝士稍各引去，惟憲衛侍左右。

manualTranslations.zh: 至德元年，太子加元服，二年，行釋奠之禮，憲於是表請解職，後主不許，給扶二人，進號雲麾將軍，置佐史。
manualTranslations.literal: In Zhide 1, the crown prince received the capping ceremony; in the second year, he performed the libation ceremony. Xian then submitted a memorial asking to resign, but the Later Lord did not permit it, gave him two aides for support, advanced his title to General of the Cloud Banner, and established a staff for him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Zhide 1, the crown prince was capped, and in the second year he performed the libation ceremony. Xian then memorialized asking to resign, but the Later Lord refused, assigned him two attendants, advanced him to General of the Cloud Banner, and gave him a staff.

manualTranslations.zh: 皇太子頗不率典訓，憲手表陳諫凡十條，皆援引古今，言辭切直，太子雖外示容納，而心無悛改。
manualTranslations.literal: The crown prince was rather unwilling to follow canonical instruction; Xian personally memorialized ten admonitions, all citing ancient and recent examples, with words urgent and direct. Although the crown prince outwardly showed acceptance, in his heart he did not reform.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The crown prince often failed to follow proper instruction, so Xian personally submitted ten admonitory memorials, each citing ancient and recent examples in direct language. The crown prince outwardly accepted them but did not change.

manualTranslations.zh: 後主欲立寵姬張貴妃子始安王為嗣，嘗從容言之，吏部尚書蔡徵順旨稱賞，憲厲色折之曰：「皇太子國家儲嗣，億兆宅心。
manualTranslations.literal: The Later Lord wished to establish the Prince of Shi'an, son of his favored consort Noble Consort Zhang, as heir, and once spoke of it at leisure. Minister of Personnel Cai Zheng followed his intent and praised the idea, but Xian sternly rebuked him, saying: "The crown prince is the state's reserve heir, on whom the hearts of all the people are fixed.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The Later Lord wanted to make the Prince of Shi'an, son of his favorite consort Noble Consort Zhang, his heir, and once mentioned it casually. Minister of Personnel Cai Zheng echoed his wishes and praised the idea, but Xian sternly rebuked him: "The crown prince is the heir of the state, and the hearts of the people rest on him.

manualTranslations.zh: 卿是何人，輕言廢立！」
manualTranslations.literal: Who are you, to speak lightly of deposing and enthroning!"
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Who are you to speak lightly of deposing and enthroning!"

manualTranslations.zh: 夏，竟廢太子為吳興王。
manualTranslations.literal: In summer, the crown prince was finally deposed as Prince of Wuxing.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: That summer, the crown prince was finally deposed as Prince of Wuxing.

manualTranslations.zh: 後主知憲有規諫之事，歎曰「袁德章實骨鯁之臣」，即日詔為尚書僕射。
manualTranslations.literal: When the Later Lord learned that Xian had remonstrated, he sighed and said, "Yuan Dezhang is truly a minister of bone and backbone," and that same day issued an edict making him Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When the Later Lord learned of Xian's remonstrance, he sighed, "Yuan Dezhang is truly a minister with backbone," and that same day appointed him vice director of the Department of State Affairs.

manualTranslations.zh: 禎明三年，隋軍來伐，隋將賀若弼進燒宮城北掖門，宮衛皆散走，朝士稍各引去，惟憲衛侍左右。
manualTranslations.literal: In Zhenming 3, Sui armies came to attack; Sui general He Ruobi advanced and burned the North Wing Gate of the palace city. The palace guards all fled, and court officials gradually withdrew one by one; only Xian guarded and attended at the ruler's side.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Zhenming 3, the Sui invaded. The Sui general He Ruobi advanced and burned the palace city's North Wing Gate; the guards fled and courtiers gradually slipped away, while only Xian stayed at the emperor's side.

sourceRange.text: 中大通三年，梁昭明太子薨，其嗣華容公不得立，乃以晉安王為皇太子，弘正乃奏記曰：

context.beforeSource: 普通中，初置司文義郎，直壽光省，以弘正為司義侍郎。
context.afterSource: 夫以廟堂、汾水，殊途而同歸，稷、契、巢、許，異名而一貫，出者稱為元首，處者謂之外臣，莫不內外相資，表裏成治，斯蓋萬代同規，百王不易者也。

manualTranslations.zh: 中大通三年，梁昭明太子薨，其嗣華容公不得立，乃以晉安王為皇太子，弘正乃奏記曰：
manualTranslations.literal: In Zhong Datong 3, Crown Prince Zhaoming of Liang died; his heir, the Duke of Huarong, could not be established, and so the Prince of Jin'an was made crown prince. Hongzheng then submitted a memorandum:
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Zhong Datong 3, Crown Prince Zhaoming of Liang died. His heir, the Duke of Huarong, could not be installed, so the Prince of Jin'an was made crown prince, and Hongzheng submitted a memorandum:

sourceRange.text: 大同元年，釋褐祕書郎。太清二年，遷太子舍人。侯景寇逆，憲東之吳郡，尋丁父憂，哀毀過禮。敬帝承制，徵授尚書殿中郎。高祖作相，除司徒戶曹。永定元年，授中書侍郎，兼散騎常侍。與黃門侍郎王瑜使齊，數年不遣，天嘉初乃還。四年，詔復中書侍郎，直侍中省。太建元年，除給事黃門侍郎，仍知太常事。二年，轉尚書吏部侍郎，尋除散騎常侍，侍東宮。三年，遷御史中丞，領羽林監。時豫章王叔英不奉法度，逼取人馬，憲依事劾奏，叔英由是坐免黜，自是朝野皆嚴憚焉。

context.beforeSource: 以貴公子選尚南沙公主，即梁簡文之女也。
context.afterSource: 憲詳練朝章，尤明聽斷，至有獄情未盡而有司具法者，即伺閑暇，常為上言之，其所申理者甚眾。
context.beforeLocal: 以貴公子選尚南沙公主，即梁簡文之女也。
context.afterLocal: 憲詳練朝章，尤明聽斷，至有獄情未盡而有司具法者，即伺閑暇，常為上言之，其所申理者甚眾。

manualTranslations.zh: 大同元年，釋褐祕書郎。
manualTranslations.literal: In Datong 1, Xian removed his plain clothes and became secretary gentleman.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Datong 1, Xian entered office as a secretary gentleman.

manualTranslations.zh: 太清二年，遷太子舍人。
manualTranslations.literal: In Taiqing 2, he was promoted to attendant to the crown prince.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Taiqing 2, he was promoted to attendant to the crown prince.

manualTranslations.zh: 侯景寇逆，憲東之吳郡，尋丁父憂，哀毀過禮。
manualTranslations.literal: When Hou Jing invaded and rebelled, Xian went east to Wu Commandery; soon he encountered mourning for his father, and his grief injured him beyond ritual requirements.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Hou Jing rebelled, Xian went east to Wu Commandery. Soon afterward his father died, and his grief exceeded the demands of ritual.

manualTranslations.zh: 敬帝承制，徵授尚書殿中郎。
manualTranslations.literal: When Emperor Jing acted under provisional authority, Xian was summoned and appointed palace gentleman in the Department of State Affairs.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Emperor Jing assumed provisional authority, Xian was summoned and appointed palace gentleman in the Department of State Affairs.

manualTranslations.zh: 高祖作相，除司徒戶曹。
manualTranslations.literal: When Gaozu served as chief minister, Xian was appointed household bureau officer under the Minister of Education.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Gaozu became chief minister, Xian was appointed household bureau officer under the minister of education.

manualTranslations.zh: 永定元年，授中書侍郎，兼散騎常侍。
manualTranslations.literal: In Yongding 1, he was appointed secretariat gentleman and concurrently Cavalier Attendant.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Yongding 1, he was appointed secretariat gentleman while concurrently serving as Cavalier Attendant.

manualTranslations.zh: 與黃門侍郎王瑜使齊，數年不遣，天嘉初乃還。
manualTranslations.literal: He went as envoy to Qi with Huangmen Gentleman Wang Yu; for several years they were not sent back, and only at the beginning of Tianjia did they return.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He went as envoy to Qi with Huangmen Gentleman Wang Yu. They were detained for several years and returned only at the beginning of Tianjia.

manualTranslations.zh: 四年，詔復中書侍郎，直侍中省。
manualTranslations.literal: In the fourth year, an edict restored him as secretariat gentleman, serving on duty in the Palace Attendant office.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, he was restored by edict as secretariat gentleman and assigned to duty in the Palace Attendant office.

manualTranslations.zh: 太建元年，除給事黃門侍郎，仍知太常事。
manualTranslations.literal: In Taijian 1, he was appointed service-providing Huangmen gentleman and remained in charge of Ministry of Ceremonies affairs.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Taijian 1, he became service-providing Huangmen gentleman while continuing to oversee Ministry of Ceremonies affairs.

manualTranslations.zh: 二年，轉尚書吏部侍郎，尋除散騎常侍，侍東宮。
manualTranslations.literal: In the second year, he was transferred to be personnel bureau gentleman in the Department of State Affairs, and soon was appointed Cavalier Attendant, serving in the Eastern Palace.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the second year, he was transferred to the personnel bureau of the Department of State Affairs, then soon appointed Cavalier Attendant and assigned to serve in the Eastern Palace.

manualTranslations.zh: 三年，遷御史中丞，領羽林監。
manualTranslations.literal: In the third year, he was promoted to vice censor-in-chief and concurrently superintendent of the Feathered Forest Guard.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the third year, he was promoted to vice censor-in-chief and concurrently superintendent of the Feathered Forest Guard.

manualTranslations.zh: 時豫章王叔英不奉法度，逼取人馬，憲依事劾奏，叔英由是坐免黜，自是朝野皆嚴憚焉。
manualTranslations.literal: At the time Prince Shuying of Yuzhang did not observe laws and regulations and forcibly seized men and horses; Xian impeached him according to the facts, and Shuying was thereby dismissed and demoted. From then on, court and countryside all sternly feared Xian.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At the time Prince Shuying of Yuzhang ignored the law and forcibly seized men and horses. Xian impeached him on the facts, leading to Shuying's dismissal and demotion; from then on, court and country alike stood in awe of Xian.

sourceRange.text: ，武帝撰孔子正言章句，詔下國學，宣制旨義。

localRange.text: 大同八年，武帝撰孔子正言章句，詔下國學，宣制旨義。

context.afterSource: 憲時年十四，被召為國子正言生，謁祭酒到溉，溉目而送之，愛其神彩。

sourceRange.text: 確字士潛，美容儀，寬大有行檢，博涉經史，篤好玄言，世父弘正特所鍾愛。解褐梁太學博士、司徒祭酒、晉安王主簿。高祖受禪，除尚書殿中郎，累遷安成王限內記室。高宗即位，授東宮通事舍人，丁母憂，去職。及歐陽紇平，起為中書舍人，命於廣州慰勞，服闋，為太常卿。歷太子中庶子、尚書左丞、太子家令，以父憂去職。尋起為貞威將軍、吳令，確固辭不之官。至德元年，授太子左衛率、中書舍人，遷散騎常侍，加貞威將軍、信州南平王府長史，行揚州事。為政平允，稱為良吏。遷都官尚書。禎明初，遘疾，卒于官，時年五十九。詔贈散騎常侍、太常卿，官給喪事。

context.afterSource: 袁憲字德章，尚書左僕射樞之弟也。

manualTranslations.zh: 確字士潛，美容儀，寬大有行檢，博涉經史，篤好玄言，世父弘正特所鍾愛。
manualTranslations.literal: Que, styled Shiqian, was handsome in appearance, broad-minded, and had conduct and restraint; he read widely in the classics and histories, deeply loved abstruse discourse, and was especially cherished by his elder kinsman Hongzheng.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Que, styled Shiqian, was handsome, broad-minded, and disciplined. He read widely in the classics and histories, loved abstruse discussion, and was especially cherished by his senior kinsman Hongzheng.

manualTranslations.zh: 解褐梁太學博士、司徒祭酒、晉安王主簿。
manualTranslations.literal: He entered office as Erudite of the Liang Imperial University, libationer to the Minister of Education, and chief clerk to the Prince of Jin'an.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He began his career as an erudite at the Liang Imperial University, then served as libationer to the minister of education and chief clerk to the Prince of Jin'an.

manualTranslations.zh: 高祖受禪，除尚書殿中郎，累遷安成王限內記室。
manualTranslations.literal: When Gaozu received the abdication, Que was appointed palace gentleman in the Department of State Affairs and was repeatedly promoted to inner secretary to the Prince of Ancheng.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Gaozu accepted the abdication, Que was appointed palace gentleman in the Department of State Affairs and later rose to inner secretary to the Prince of Ancheng.

manualTranslations.zh: 高宗即位，授東宮通事舍人，丁母憂，去職。
manualTranslations.literal: When Gaozong ascended, Que was appointed communications attendant in the Eastern Palace; when his mother died, he left office.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Gaozong took the throne, Que became communications attendant in the Eastern Palace, but left office when his mother died.

manualTranslations.zh: 及歐陽紇平，起為中書舍人，命於廣州慰勞，服闋，為太常卿。
manualTranslations.literal: After Ouyang He was pacified, Que was recalled as secretariat attendant and ordered to Guangzhou to console and reward; after mourning ended, he became Minister of Ceremonies.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: After Ouyang He was subdued, Que was recalled as secretariat attendant and sent to Guangzhou to console and reward the region. When his mourning ended, he became minister of ceremonies.

manualTranslations.zh: 歷太子中庶子、尚書左丞、太子家令，以父憂去職。
manualTranslations.literal: He served successively as chief aide to the crown prince, left assistant in the Department of State Affairs, and household steward to the crown prince, then left office for mourning for his father.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He later served as chief aide to the crown prince, left assistant in the Department of State Affairs, and steward of the crown prince's household, before leaving office to mourn his father.

manualTranslations.zh: 尋起為貞威將軍、吳令，確固辭不之官。
manualTranslations.literal: Soon he was recalled as General of Steadfast Might and magistrate of Wu, but Que firmly declined and did not take office.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was soon recalled as General of Steadfast Might and magistrate of Wu, but firmly declined and never took up the post.

manualTranslations.zh: 至德元年，授太子左衛率、中書舍人，遷散騎常侍，加貞威將軍、信州南平王府長史，行揚州事。
manualTranslations.literal: In Zhide 1, he was appointed left guard commander to the crown prince and secretariat attendant; he was promoted to Cavalier Attendant, additionally made General of Steadfast Might and chief steward of the Prince of Nanping's office in Xinzhou, and acted in Yangzhou affairs.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Zhide 1, he became left guard commander to the crown prince and secretariat attendant, then was promoted to Cavalier Attendant, additionally named General of Steadfast Might and chief steward of the Prince of Nanping's office in Xinzhou, and put in charge of Yangzhou affairs.

manualTranslations.zh: 為政平允，稱為良吏。
manualTranslations.literal: His governance was even and fair, and he was called a good official.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His administration was fair and even-handed, and he was praised as a good official.

manualTranslations.zh: 遷都官尚書。
manualTranslations.literal: He was promoted to Minister of the Bureau of Justice.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was promoted to minister of the Bureau of Justice.

manualTranslations.zh: 禎明初，遘疾，卒于官，時年五十九。
manualTranslations.literal: At the beginning of Zhenming, he contracted illness and died in office, aged fifty-nine.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Early in the Zhenming era, he fell ill and died in office at the age of fifty-nine.

manualTranslations.zh: 詔贈散騎常侍、太常卿，官給喪事。
manualTranslations.literal: An edict posthumously bestowed Cavalier Attendant and Minister of Ceremonies, and the government supplied the funeral expenses.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: By edict he was posthumously granted the titles Cavalier Attendant and minister of ceremonies, with funeral expenses supplied by the state.

sourceRange.text: __TOC__裴忌字無畏，河東聞喜人也。祖髦，梁中散大夫。父之平，倜儻有志略，召補文德主帥。梁普通中眾軍北伐，之平隨都督夏侯亶克定渦、潼，以功封費縣侯。會衡州部民相聚寇抄，詔以之平為假節、超武將軍、都督衡州五郡征討諸軍事。及之平至，即皆平殄，梁武帝甚嘉賞之。元帝承聖中，累遷散騎常侍、右衛將軍、晉陵太守。世祖即位，除光祿大夫，慈訓宮衛尉，並不就，乃築山穿池，植以卉木，居處其中，有終焉之志。卒，贈仁威將軍、光祿大夫，諡曰僖子。

sourceRange.text: 禎明元年，入為都官尚書。自晉以來，尚書官僚皆攜家屬居省。省在臺城內下舍門，中有閣道，東西跨路，通于朝堂。其第一即都官之省，西抵閣道，年代久遠，多有鬼怪，每昏夜之際，無故有聲光，或見人著衣冠從井中出，須臾復沒，或門閤自然開閉。居省者多死亡，尚書周確卒於此省，孝克代確，便即居之，經涉兩載，妖變皆息，時人咸以為貞正所致。

sourceRange.text: 後主即位，除祠部尚書，又領左驍騎將軍，參掌選事。轉散騎常侍、吏部尚書。尋遷尚書僕射，參掌如故。，加宣惠將軍，量置佐史。尋授尚書令，給鼓吹一部，加扶，餘並如故。策曰：「於戲，夫文昌政本，司會治經，韋彪謂之樞機，李固方之斗極。況其五曹斯綜，百揆是諧，同冢宰之司，專臺閣之任。惟爾道業標峻，宇量弘深，勝範清規，風流以為准的，辭宗學府，衣冠以為領袖。故能師長六官，具瞻允塞，明府八座，儀形載遠，其端朝握揆，朕所望焉。往欽哉，懋建爾徽猷，亮采我邦國，可不慎歟！」，進號中權將軍。京城陷，入隋，為上開府。，卒於江都，時年七十六。總嘗自敘其略曰：歷升清顯，備位朝列，不邀世利，不涉權幸。

manualTranslations.literal: The appointment document said: "Ah! Wenchang is the root of government, and the office of accounts governs its canons; Wei Biao called it the pivot, and Li Gu compared it to the pole star. How much more when its five bureaus are all brought together and the hundred duties are harmonized, matching the office of the minister of state and holding sole responsibility for the state secretariat. Your way and achievement are lofty, your capacity deep and broad; your excellent model and pure standard are what the refined take as their measure, and in literary circles and scholarly offices the gentlemen take you as their leader. Thus you can serve as teacher and elder to the six offices, fully satisfying what all look to; as a bright official among the eight seats, your model will be carried far. That you stand upright in court and hold the balance is what I hope for. Go reverently! Diligently build your fine plans and brightly aid our state. Can you fail to be careful?"
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The appointment document said: "Ah! Wenchang is the root of government; the accounting office orders its rules. Wei Biao called it the pivot, and Li Gu compared it to the pole star. Its five bureaus bring matters together and harmonize the hundred duties, matching the charge of the minister of state and holding the responsibilities of the state secretariat. Your moral practice is lofty and your capacity deep; the refined take your pure standard as their measure, and scholars and gentlemen take you as their leader. You can therefore guide the six offices and satisfy the hopes of all; as one of the eight seats, your example will carry far. To stand upright at court and hold the balance is what I expect of you. Go reverently, build your fine plans, and brightly aid our state. Can you fail to be careful?"

sourceRange.text: ，進號鎮北將軍。高宗輔政，不欲令伯山處邊，，徙為鎮東將軍、東揚州刺史。，徵為中衛將軍、中領軍。六年，又為征北將軍、南徐州刺史。尋為征南將軍、江州刺史。十一年，入為護軍將軍，加開府儀同三司，〔四〕仍給鼓吹并扶。後主即位，進號中權大將軍。，出為持節、都督東揚豐二州諸軍事、東揚州刺史，加侍中，餘並如故。，丁所生母憂，去職。明年，起為鎮衛大將軍、〔五〕開府儀同三司，給班劍十人。三年正月薨，時年四十。伯山性寬厚，美風儀，又於諸王最長，後主深敬重之，每朝廷有冠婚饗醼之事，恆使伯山為主。及丁所生母憂，居喪以孝聞。後主嘗幸吏部尚書蔡徵宅，因往弔之，伯山號慟殆絕，因起為鎮衛將軍，仍謂群臣曰：「鄱陽王至性可嘉，又是西第之長，豫章已兼司空，其亦須遷太尉。」未及發詔而伯山薨，尋值陳亡，遂無贈諡。

sourceRange.text: 晉安王伯恭字肅之，世祖第六子也。，立為晉安王。尋為平東將軍、吳郡太守，置佐史。時伯恭年十餘歲，便留心政事，官曹治理。，入為安前將軍、中護軍，遷中領軍。尋為中衛將軍、揚州刺史，以公事免。四年，起為安左將軍，尋為鎮右將軍、特進，給扶。六年，出為安南將軍、南豫州刺史。九年，入為安前將軍、祠部尚書。十一年，進號軍師將軍、尚書右僕射。十二年，遷僕射。十三年，遷左僕射，十四年，出為安南將軍、湘州刺史，未拜。，為侍中、中衛將軍、光祿大夫，丁所生母憂，去職。禎明元年，起為中衛將軍、右光祿大夫，置佐史、扶並如故。三年入關。隋大業初，為成州刺史、太常卿。

sourceRange.text: 豫章王叔英字子烈，高宗第三子也。少寬厚仁愛。，封建安侯。，改封豫章王，仍為宣惠將軍、都督東揚州諸軍事、東揚州刺史。五年，進號平北將軍、南豫州刺史。〔二一〕十一年，為鎮前將軍、江州刺史。〔二二〕後主即位，進號征南將軍，尋加開府儀同三司、中衛大將軍，餘並如故。四年，進號驃騎大將軍〔二三〕。，給鼓吹一部，班劍十人。其年，遷司空。〔二四〕三年，隋師濟江，叔英知石頭軍戍事。尋令入屯朝堂。及六軍敗績，降于隋將韓擒虎。其年入關。隋大業中為涪陵太守。長子弘，，拜豫章國世子。

sourceRange.text: 高宗即位，除給事黃門侍郎，兼中書舍人，典軍國機密。高宗將議北伐，敕喜撰軍制，凡十三條，詔頒天下，文多不載。尋遷太子右衛率、右衛將軍。以定策功，封東昌縣侯，邑五百戶。又以本官行江夏、武陵、桂陽三王府國事。，丁母憂去職，詔追贈喜母庾氏東昌國太夫人，賜布五百匹，錢三十萬，官給喪事。又遣員外散騎常侍杜緬圖其墓田，高宗親與緬案圖指畫，其見重如此。尋起為明威將軍，右衛、舍人如故。改授宣遠將軍、義興太守。尋以本號入為御史中丞。服闋，加散騎常侍、五兵尚書，參掌選事。
